note: One real session of GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.105 over ACP, started as vscode/src/agents/acp.ts starts it (COPILOT: copilot --acp --allow-tool=benchscout --additional-mcp-config <benchscout relay>), driven with the official SDK client as acp.ts drives it, against a core on fixtures/bench_example.json, 2026-11-08 (audit 2026-11-07, T27). dir out: what Copilot sent; dir in: what was sent to it (the shell command denied, as the inbox does). bench_scan ran without a permission ask (--allow-tool); without that flag Copilot asked for it like any tool. Denying the shell command ended the turn. Redacted: the session id, paths, and the person's own skills in the command list.
